title: Worlds Within
subtitle: Every picture is another place.
description: Zoom through a desk's postcard city, a building's reading room, and a book's island sea. Four original illustrated worlds nest inside one another with focal-point-preserving zoom, pan, and touch pinch.
medium: Recursive vector atlas and geometric zoom
instruction: Scroll or pinch over the picture to zoom. Drag to pan, or tap the framed postcard to enter its world.
